name: heat_full_s0
problem: Given noisy temperature measurements at four sensor locations over time, recover the four unknown piecewise-constant thermal conductivities of a 1-D rod governed by the heat equation.

notes: Models may only be trained on simulated data; the test split is never used for selection

objectives: Learn a regression model from simulated data (python) that solves: Given noisy temperature measurements at four sensor locations over time, recover the four unknown piecewise-constant thermal conductivities of a 1-D rod governed by the heat equation.
Select methods by validation rel_l2 only; the test split is used exactly once, at the end
Stay within 400 worker-seconds of compute and 1700 s wall time
Eliminate weak approaches with cheap feasibility checks before spending substantial compute
Constraint: Models may only be trained on simulated data; the test split is never used for selection
simulator_description: 1-D heat equation u_t = (k(x) u_x)_x on [0,1] with Dirichlet ends; unknown piecewise-constant conductivity k (targets); features are noisy temperatures at sensor points over time.
